newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Extreme poverty said to drop sharply in Colombia.
newsitem.headline: Extreme poverty said to drop sharply in Colombia.

text.p: Extreme poverty in Colombia has dropped sharply over the past decade but 10 percent of Colombians still live in conditions of "absolute misery," the government said on Monday.
A report from the comptroller general's office gave no reason for the drop in the overall number of people living far below the poverty line.
But it said the number living in "absolute misery" had fallen to 10 percent from 22 percent of the population in the mid-1980s.

The report also said the number of people living without basic necessities had fallen from 43.31 percent of the population in 1985 to 29.2 percent in 1994, the last year for which official statistics were available.
